name: Luna 13

narrator.name: Luna 13
narrator.role: the lander with a soil-poking arm

intro: I brought a little arm that pokes the ground, like a spoon testing pudding.
My batteries are good for about four days, then I take a long nap.
Where should I test the lunar pudding?
briefing: We are coming down over Oceanus Procellarum again.
Choose where I land so I can poke the soil in daylight.
fact: Luna 13 measured how hard the lunar soil is: about as firm as packed garden soil.
